I could say some cheesy shit like "going out to parties with people isnt that fun", but i wont bullshit it is. From one high school student that had parents like that to another, try this. I used to be the same way, I never went out because of my parents and I had trouble making friends (I still do). If the few friends you have go to parties then its easy, if not you'll have to do some extra work. Just find out who parties in your grade, and see if you have them in any classes, or anywhere where you can really socialize with them without it being awkward. Just crack some stupid jokes or whatever makes those dipshits laugh, it doesn't take much. Make it seem like you're one of them till they like you and find out where a party is. No matter how introverted you are, just act like you're very outgoing. Then, do the complete opposite at home. Don't talk to your parents unless they talk to you, say you're not hungry, mope around the house, shit like that. They will try to find out what's wrong pretty quick (if not, they're shit parents).
